metadata.description:
PowerGenome input data assembled from public sources. This release corresponds to data/manifest.json data version 2026.08.14.

This is the initial release of this dataset. All 17 files are new in this version.

Each data element's own version key records when that element was last updated; the per-file sources below document where it came from.

cpi_data.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md50dcf40c82a204b361f9da0fdc7070550
  • Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=CPIAUCNS — U.S. CPI-U (All Urban Consumers, All Items, NSA), annual averages via FRED with BLS public API fallback (superseded by dollar_year_adjustment.csv).

distributed_capacity.parquet

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5d8c206063044ea93edb80e8cae100357
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/main/inputs/dgen_model_inputs/stscen2023_mid_case/distpvcap_stscen2023_mid_case.csv — ReEDS distributed PV capacity by county (stscen2023_mid_case scenario), aggregated county -> BA and converted DC to AC (ILR 1.1) by build_new_pg_dg_inputs.py.
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/main/inputs/county2zone.csv — ReEDS county-to-zone mapping used to aggregate capacity to balancing areas.

distributed_profiles.parquet

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md539a54bb4fc2bf42287d66ceadb90714f
  • Source: https://github.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/raw/main/inputs/variability/multi_year/distpv-reference_ba.h5 — ReEDS distributed PV generation profiles (multi-year distpv-reference_ba.h5), processed by build_new_pg_dg_inputs.py.

dollar_year_adjustment.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md52e819d4d7f465d8d273b2da57f0a2fd1
  • Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=A191RD3A086NBEA — U.S. Implicit Price Deflator for Gross Domestic Product (GDP-IPD, index 2017=100), annual, from FRED with BEA NIPA API fallback.

fuel_prices.parquet

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5a5393175e8eabda1134e849ceeb6f5e1
  • Source: https://www.eia.gov/opendata/bulk/AEO2026.zip — EIA Annual Energy Outlook (AEO) bulk data: 'Energy Prices : Electric Power' series by census division / scenario / fuel, mapped to ReEDS Balancing Areas by .github/skills/eia-fuel-prices.

nerc_reserve_margins.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5b8ac4f0a59127c9e483d9b59aaad78b4
  • Source: https://www.nerc.com/globalassets/our-work/assessments/nerc_ltra_2025.pdf — NERC Long-Term Reliability Assessment (LTRA) 'Reference Margin Level (%)' by assessment area, extracted by .github/skills/nerc-reserve-margins and carried forward through 2050.

nerc_reserve_margins_vintage.json

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5f10aef2af51faa5d227ec513262077c2
  • Source: Sidecar vintage metadata (report year, source URL, retrieval timestamp) written alongside nerc_reserve_margins.csv by the NERC reserve margins extractor.

operational_constraints_reeds.csv

Data element version2026-08-14
Last updated2026-08-14
md575b7e22488de8048e56c1e1f81c359f9
  • Source: https://github.com/ReEDS-Model/ReEDS/blob/main/inputs/plant_characteristics/pcm_defaults.json — ReEDS plant characterization module (PCM) defaults (pcm_defaults.json), transformed by build_operational_constraints_reeds.py into PowerGenome operational constraints.

plant_region_map.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md50d8a6f43695c230a418827820f071dd8
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/refs/heads/main/inputs/capacity_exogenous/ReEDS_generator_database_final_EIA-NEMS.csv — ReEDS generator database (ReEDS_generator_database_final_EIA-NEMS.csv) as the plant list, joined to ReEDS zones by transform_reeds_generators.py.
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/refs/heads/main/inputs/county2zone.csv — ReEDS county-to-zone mapping (county2zone.csv) used to assign each plant to a model region.

reeds_generators_transformed.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md51dfff9c035410c487687ee9da9c85395
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/refs/heads/main/inputs/capacity_exogenous/ReEDS_generator_database_final_EIA-NEMS.csv — ReEDS generator database (ReEDS_generator_database_final_EIA-NEMS.csv) cleaned and transformed by transform_reeds_generators.py.
  • Source: https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/pudl.catalyst.coop/nightly/out_eia__yearly_generators.parquet — PUDL/EIA yearly generators parquet, used for retirement info on existing units.

reeds_load_transformed.parquet

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md52a6c49b1cd3ea175b776ce853f06485e
  • Source: https://github.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/raw/main/inputs/load/EER_IRAlow_load_hourly.h5 — ReEDS hourly load HDF5 (EER_IRAlow_load_hourly.h5, LFS-backed), filtered to weather years 2007-2013 and model years 2020-2050 by transform_reeds_load.py.

regional_cost_multipliers.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md56c46df3480cbecd82ac1d724f4255658
  • Source: https://www.eia.gov/analysis/studies/powerplants/capitalcost/pdf/capital_cost_AEO2025.pdf — EIA capital cost AEO2025 PDF tables mapped to PowerGenome technologies/regions by extract_location_variation.py.

reserve_margins.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5597fc25a77553b29217ea35037258d73
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ReEDS-Model/ReEDS/main/inputs/reserves/prm_annual.csv — ReEDS planning reserve margins (prm_annual.csv) joined to NERC regions via the ReEDS hierarchy by build_reserve_margins.py.

technology_costs_atb.parquet

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md54c65c88129c4db3d0df180c3eb28a3ec
  • Source: https://data.openei.org/s3_viewer?bucket=oedi-data-lake&prefix=ATB%2Felectricity%2Fcsv%2F2024%2Fv4.0.0%2F&limit=50 — NREL ATB 2024 v4

technology_heat_rates_nrelatb.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5356c16b73d98fd6ac2dcf95510701630
  • Source: https://data.openei.org/s3_viewer?bucket=oedi-data-lake&prefix=ATB%2Felectricity%2Fcsv%2F2024%2Fv4.0.0%2F&limit=50 — NREL ATB 2024 v4

transmission_capacity_merged.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5997c77e87202c9e96b852b154dd13d78
  • Source: Unknown - document me

transmission_capacity_reeds.csv

Data element version2026-08-11
Last updated2026-08-11
md5afed76f028868aae1d68c095bca01f24
  • Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NREL/ReEDS-2.0/main/inputs/transmission/transmission_capacity_init_AC_ba_NARIS2024.csv — ReEDS AC and non-AC transmission capacity files merged by merge_transmission_capacity.py.
